title: Smooth quotient model of a compatible residue-field algebra
statement: Let $A_0$ be a complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring] Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] commutative local ring and $E$ a complete Noetherian commutative local ring. Give $E$ both an $A_0$-algebra and a $k_0=A_0/\mathfrak m_0$-algebra structure, with the scalar tower $A_0\to k_0\to E$ equal to the specified $A_0$ action. If $E$ is formally smooth over $k_0$ for its maximal-ideal topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic], then for an arbitrary type $A$ there exists a complete Noetherian local $A_0$-algebra $C$ in the maximum universe of $A_0,A,E$, whose local structure map $\gamma$ is adically formally smooth, and a surjection $\theta:C\to E$ with kernel $\mathfrak m_0C$ and $\theta\gamma$ equal to the specified $A_0$ structure map.

proof.text: Apply Algebra.exists_formallySmoothAdic_lift_residue_field to the compatible residue-field algebra E. Its scalar-tower hypothesis holds by assumption. It gives C and an A₀-algebra isomorphism σ:C/m₀C≃E with C complete Noetherian local and its local structure map formally smooth.
Compose σ with the quotient map to obtain θ. Surjectivity follows from both factors; injectivity of σ identifies its kernel with m₀C. The algebra-map compatibility of σ gives θγ=algebraMap A₀ E.

Replace C by ULift C. Mathlib transports the local and Noetherian structures, the maximal ideal, and adic completeness through the canonical ring equivalence. Apply Algebra.formallySmoothAdic_ulift for the lifting property in the enlarged test universe. Its proof constructs the small test algebra as the quotient of a polynomial ring by the evaluation kernel. Transport the quotient map, its kernel, and algebra compatibility through the canonical algebra equivalence.
